## Quiz play

- Total EXP now determines the leaderboard. EXP earned from answers, streaks and Spark exchanges counts toward rank and levels. Existing progress is carried forward.
- Server managers and Dilemma managers can use `/dilemma custom` to publish a one-off quiz from a topic or exact question. Choose 2-4 generated answers and 1-6 hours of voting. Custom and random each allow four quizzes per server day, at least six hours apart in each mode.
- The vote preview and 50/50 are free. Each player has one use of each per server week. Both renew on Mondays in the server's timezone.
- New bets use 1-10 Sparks on easy, 10-25 on medium and 25-50 on hard. Existing stakes and payouts are preserved.

## Quiz corrections

- Approved corrections appear in **My result**, alongside the player's refund details and streak recovery.
- Players whose streak was broken by a corrected quiz have their current and best streak recalculated. The approved correction skips that quiz when counting their streak.
- The private review uses **Edit suggested fix** / **Edytuj poprawkę**. The owner can approve generation rules for future random, custom, manual and scheduled quizzes across servers.

## Player guide

- Dilemma updates registered guides in their original message when the Polish or English text changes. After the release is public on GitHub, it posts significant changes separately on registered guide channels.

## Upgrade from v3.12.0

- Apply the six PostgreSQL migrations after verifying a backup. They cover streak correction, generation rules, EXP conversion, custom quiz quotas, weekly lifelines and stake validation, and guide text tracking.
- Re-register the Discord commands to enable `/dilemma custom` and publish the updated command descriptions.
